title: Using dual-layer server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (DSSE-KMS)
note: Q1 LW fix (Amendment 3): DSSE-KMS applies two independent AES-256 encryption layers (a KMS-generated data key, then a separate S3-managed key) to satisfy compliance requirements for multilayer encryption; it costs more than single-layer SSE-KMS due to additional KMS operations and processing overhead, and S3 Bucket Keys are not supported for it.
